entities.summary: Eben Etzebeth is a South African professional rugby union player who currently plays for the Sharks in the United Rugby Championship and the South Africa national team. He made his international debut for the Springboks in 2012 and has since played 141 caps, making him the Springboks' most capped player. His regular playing position is as a tighthead lock.
